output.subject: termdiff: side-by-side word-level diffs in 38ms
output.pitch: Console.dev readers live in the terminal and review diffs daily. termdiff replaces git's default pager with a side-by-side, word-level highlighted view that renders a 10,000-line diff in 38ms — an order of magnitude faster than existing tools. It’s a zero-config static binary, already in Homebrew core, and trusted by engineers at monorepo scale. No setup, no config, just drop it in and run git diff. {APP_URL}
